channel.title: Madeira Ativa — island news
channel.description: Daily news digest from Madeira: sport, events, trails and island life, curated by Madeira Ativa.

item.title: Finance Service will operate provisionally on Travessa dos Reis
item.description: From Monday onwards. The Finance Service of Funchal 2 will operate provisionally, from next Monday, at Travessa dos Reis, no. 18. According to information from the Regional Finance Department, this change is due to the carrying out of improvement works. (via JM Madeira)

item.title: "Our way of doing politics has also crossed the sea"
item.description: The Municipal Authorities Days were divided into three panels. The first, "Being a Municipal Authority of JPP", moderated by Mariusky Spínola, addressed the experience of those who know local power from within, including Filipe Sousa, Luís Gaspar, president of the Parish Assembly of Caniço and Vice-President of the Assembly. (via JM Madeira)

item.title: "We are here paying the bills and counting every penny"
item.description: The increase in cost of living, rising prices in supermarkets and difficulties in accessing housing were among the main complaints presented by Manuel Aguiar, organizer of the demonstration held this Saturday. Manuel Aguiar, organizer of the demonstration that is still ongoing. (via JM Madeira)

item.title: Four proposals submitted for Caminho da Barreira and Curral Velho
item.description: Work between Caminho da Barreira and Curral Velho will be ready to proceed on the ground in early 2027 and will strengthen fire prevention and fighting, directly benefiting around a thousand families. Four proposals were submitted to the public tender for the work. (via JM Madeira)

item.title: About two dozen at concentration against the cost of living increase (with photos)
item.description: Under the motto 'We can't take it anymore', the initiative aims to alert people to the growing difficulties families face in supporting essential expenses. item.title: Saturday dedicated to bread and bolo do caco at Jardim de Santa Luzia
item.description: Event runs until 6:00 PM. Santa Luzia Garden hosts throughout today the 7th Exhibition of Bolo do Caco and Homemade Bread of the Autonomous Region of Madeira. Until 6:00 PM, in addition to various varieties of bread from all corners of the island, there is an entire entertainment program prepared. (via JM Madeira)

item.title: ADN Madeira demands respect for regional autonomy
item.description: ADN considers that supervision is not above public scrutiny regarding the opportunity and justification of its conclusions. ADN Madeira considers that the Court of Auditors must provide explanations about the opportunity and scope of supervision of the regional support protocol to the Security Police. (via JM Madeira)

item.description: Good morning and good weekend! - Santa Catarina Park, in Funchal, hosts, from 9:15 AM, the Wanderlust Madeira festival. Throughout the day, the festival holds mindful lifestyle activities, where participants practice yoga, Pilates and meditation. - The Exhibition of Bolo do Caco and Homemade Bread. (via JM Madeira)

item.title: Madalena Fernandes in the semi-finals of Vilamoura Junior Open
item.description: With this result, Madalena Fernandes reaches, for the second consecutive week, the semifinals of singles at an international J30 tournament, after reaching the same stage last week in Portimão, where she ended up just short of the final. Madalena Fernandes continues in great form. (via JM Madeira)

item.description: The Madeiran canoeist revalidated the world title in SS1 Sub-23, in Spain, and confirmed an excellent season, in which he also won three European titles. item.title: More than 20 people in brawl with knives, irons and batons
item.description: Police were called to the scene. It was a very turbulent morning in the parish of São Roque, in Funchal. According to reports that reached the Newspaper, a brawl, involving more than 20 people, some armed with metal rods, knives and batons, is said to have alerted the police authorities. (via JM Madeira)

item.description: Madvital – Home Hospitalization & Medical Care brings together medical, nursing, rehabilitation and caregiver support services. The project positions itself as pioneering in the Region. A Madeiran project aims to strengthen home healthcare services and provide medical assistance. (via JM Madeira)

item.title: More 37 families receive support to recover homes in Funchal
item.description: Funchal Town Hall and Santo António Development Association (ASA) grant aid for the purchase of construction materials and home furnishings. The Funchal Municipal Council delivered 96,580.79 euros to 37 families, as part of the second installment of aid. (via JM Madeira)

item.description: The bill presented by Filipe Sousa foresaw the end of residents advancing the total cost of airfares and the setting of deadlines for establishing a regular maritime connection between Madeira and the mainland. item.title: Diagnostic and therapeutic technicians' strike registers 77% adherence
item.description: SESARAM recognizes the right to strike and announces that it is preparing a tender to hire senior diagnostic and therapeutic technicians. A meeting with the union is scheduled for October 19. The adhesion to the strike of senior diagnostic and therapeutic technicians of the Health Service. (via JM Madeira)

item.title: Sancho Gomes visits Madeiran families affected by earthquakes
item.description: The regional director of Communities and External Cooperation visited families in Caracas and La Guaira who received support to recover homes damaged by the earthquakes of June 24. The NGO Regala Una Sonrisa received 55 thousand euros from the 180 thousand mobilized by the Regional Government of Madeira. (via JM Madeira)

item.title: Sporting wins in Braga with comeback in second half
item.description: In eighth round match. Sporting returned today to victories in the Portuguese I League football, after two draws, by winning 3-1, with a turnaround, at the home of Sporting Braga, in an eighth round match. An own goal by goalkeeper Rui Silva, at 41 minutes, gave the advantage. (via JM Madeira)

item.title: President of the Republic congratulates Bernardo Pereira on world championship title
item.description: Madeiran canoeist became two-time world champion in his category. The President of the Republic congratulated Bernardo Pereira, athlete from Clube Naval da Calheta, on winning the world title of SS1 sub-23 in sea canoeing, achieved this Thursday in La Vila Joiosa, Spain. By revalidating the title. (via JM Madeira)

item.description: Victory over Al Diriyah, managed by Bruno Lage A goal from Cristiano Ronaldo and another from compatriot Samu Costa helped Al Nassr beat Al Diriyah (3-0), managed by Bruno Lage, in an eighth round match of the Saudi football championship. After leaving the training camp. (via JM Madeira)

item.description: The Municipal Council highlights the athlete's achievement from Clube Naval da Calheta and his example for the young people of the municipality.
